s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Today we are going to count to ten!

s01_02.text: Beep beep! We're going to Lumi's star party!

s03_01.text: I am one big yellow bus!

s03_02.text: Can you hold up one finger?

s04_01.text: Meow! I have two red balloons!

s05_01.text: Quack! Look, the fish are jumping!

s06_01.text: Ribbit! Watch me hop on the leaves!

s07_01.text: Tweet! How many apples are in my tree?

s08_01.text: Let's count our friends on the bus!

s09_01.text: How many balls can you see?

s10_01.text: Meow! I made cookies for the party!

s11_01.text: Look! A rainbow has seven colors!

s12_01.text: Ribbit! Let's build a tall tower!

s14_01.text: Tweet! The sun is going to sleep!

s15_01.text: Hello, friends! Welcome to my star party!

s16_01.text: My star friends are coming! Let's count them!

s17_01.text: Nine stars and Lumi. How many stars now?

s18_01.text: Wiggle your fingers! Let's count them!

s18_02.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!

s21_01.text: Let's count to ten one more time!

s22_01.text: One bus, two balloons, three fish, four hops!

s22_02.text: Five apples, six cookies, seven colors!

s22_03.text: Eight blocks, nine stars, and ten with Lumi!

s23_01.text: Thank you for counting with us!

s23_02.text: Beep beep! Time to go home!

s24_01.text: You counted all the way to ten!
